changelog:
0.3.0

  • Pro: button clicks, new vs returning visitors, time on page.
  • Pro+: conversion funnel, visitor snapshot, abandoned carts, device/browser/OS report.
  • Pro+: navigation flows, form submissions, marketing & AI visibility, email tracking, Microsoft Clarity recordings, accounting, All Reports + CSV.
  • Agency: insights and benchmarks.

0.2.0

  • Pro: page visits, entry & exit pages, bounce rate, session duration.
  • Pro: traffic sources — Google / Facebook organic vs ads, AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity…).
  • Pro: device type, countries, real-time recent visitors & live activity.
  • Pro: WooCommerce sales, orders, top products, sales by source.
  • License key activation.

0.1.4

  • Cleaner settings page.
  • "Delete all plugin data" on by default.
  • Optional feedback when deactivating.

0.1.3

  • Tracker no longer blocked by common ad-block lists (some visitors were missing).
  • More precise bot detection.

0.1.2

  • Dashboard → Updates → "Check again" fetches the latest version immediately.

0.1.1

  • Live visitors appear right away on sites using LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, Autoptimize (tracker excluded from JS delay).
  • Admin live view refreshes every 10 seconds.

0.1.0

  • First release: live visitors + countries.
